translations.web: But you know the proof of him, that as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
translations.bsb: But you know Timothy’s proven worth, that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.
translations.kjv: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
translations.asv: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a child serveth a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the gospel.
